body:
This change adds narrow lowering for selected 64-bit physical register-pair forms in the SASS lifter. `IADD.64` supports an R destination, R first source, and R/UR second source; `IMAD.WIDE.U32` supports R destination, R and UR scalar multiplicands, and an R 64-bit addend. It declares implicit upper words for the IMAD result/addend and `.64` descriptor-address registers, and preserves instruction predicates across the pair bridges. Unsupported wide forms are diagnosed; the change does not claim general 64-bit SASS support.

The global wide-store rejection is limited to the global path, leaving existing shared/local store lowering unchanged. The prior I2FP helper path is unchanged.

Validation on the pinned source used an isolated CPU-only harness: three targeted unit fixtures passed, and fixture-generated PTX assembled with CUDA 13.1 `ptxas -arch=sm_120`. The full workspace test suite was not run. This PR has no independent GPU validation and makes no whole-kernel correctness claim; a separate combined candidate's output result does not validate this isolated patch.
title: Preserve selected 64-bit SASS register pairs
